conbody.p: When the windshield where the front view camera is located is covered with foreign material, such as snow or rain, it can reduce the detecting performance and temporarily limit or disable Intelligent Speed Limit Assist. If this occurs, the warning message and the Intelligent Speed Limit Assist indicator light () will appear on the cluster, but it is not a failure of Intelligent Speed Limit Assist.
Warning message: Driver Assistance System limited. Camera obscured

If you drive after removing the foreign material, the Intelligent Speed Limit Assist indicator light () will turn off and Intelligent Speed ​​Limit Assist will operate properly again. Always keep it clean.

If Intelligent Speed Limit Assist does not operate properly even after foreigner material is removed, have your vehicle inspected by a professional workshop. Kia recommends visiting an authorized Kia dealer or service partner.

li.p: Even though the warning message or warning light does not appear on the cluster, Intelligent Speed Limit Assist may not operate properly.
Even if restarting the vehicle with the sensors blocked or malfunctioned, Intelligent Speed Limit Assist may not properly operate as the function maintains the broken/covered state.

note.p: You can check it in the service message of the utility information view of the cluster display window.
